formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) (x3 : Finset (PEqualNP.BicliqueBlockCost.Block x1)), PEqualNP.BicliqueBlockCost.IsBlockCover x2 x3 → (∀ x5 ∈ x3, x5.1.card ≤ (1 : ℕ) ∨ x5.2.card ≤ (1 : ℕ)) → ∃ (x6 : Finset (Fin x1)), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover x2 x6 ∧ x2.edgeSet.ncard + x6.card ≤ PEqualNP.BicliqueBlockCost.familyCost x3 + (1 : ℕ)
plain_statement: Any graph and any family of blocks covering every edge in which every block has a side with at most one vertex (a star). Then some vertex cover S has |E| + |S| at most the family's cost plus one, a block (A, B) costing |A| + |B| - 1 and the family its blocks' costs plus the number of blocks minus one.
title: A step toward: Graphs without a 4-cycle: every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates
